scripts.serve: firebase use staging && json -I -f global-config.json -e "this.FIREBASE_PROJECT='staging'" && quasar dev -m pwa
scripts.build-staging: firebase use staging && firebase firestore:indexes > firestore.indexes.json && json -I -f global-config.json -e "this.FIREBASE_PROJECT='staging'" && quasar build -m pwa
scripts.build-production: firebase use production && json -I -f global-config.json -e "this.FIREBASE_PROJECT='production'" && quasar build -m pwa
scripts.deploy-staging: firebase use staging && firebase firestore:indexes > firestore.indexes.json && json -I -f global-config.json -e "this.FIREBASE_PROJECT='staging'" && quasar build -m pwa && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy-production: firebase use production && firebase firestore:indexes > firestore.indexes.json && json -I -f global-config.json -e "this.FIREBASE_PROJECT='production'" && quasar build -m pwa && firebase deploy --only hosting
